newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO FEED ASSNS REPORT HIGHER 6-MO SALES VOLUMES.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO FEED ASSNS REPORT HIGHER 6-MO SALES VOLUMES.

text.p: Mexican feed volume sales in the first half of 1997 rose three to four percent compared to the same period last year, the United Soybean Board and American Soybean Association (USB-ASA) said Thursday in an update.
Citing preliminary reports from the Mexico City Livestock Feed Producers Association, local offices of USB-ASA said hog feed was leading the charge in hikes in Mexican feed sales.
The Guadalajara Feed Association reported first half feed sales slightly lower than the Mexico City counterpart, but declined to give a figure. Guadalajara is Mexico's second city.
"Both groups would not commit to a definite figure as they both still do not have final information on the first half," USB-ASA said.
